programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 2
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Peru, seekor anteater sutra (silky anteater) berjuang untuk tetap terjaga, sementara seekor burung kolibri betina berusaha keras membesarkan anaknya. Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Namun, dengan segala kecerdikan yang mereka miliki, mereka tidak pernah siap menghadapi kedatangan spesies baru yang muncul di habitat mereka.

programme.title: Most Amazing Walks S1, Ep 4
programme.desc: Aktor Robson Green mengajak penonton berpetualang melalui beberapa lanskap paling menakjubkan di planet ini. Setiap perjalanan dipenuhi dengan pemandangan yang memukau, sejarah yang memesona, dan satwa liar yang memesona. Sepanjang perjalanan, Robson membenamkan dirinya dalam lanskap dan kisah orang-orang yang ditemuinya, menciptakan perjalanan emosional melalui beberapa wilayah terindah di dunia.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng kabur ke San Francisco setelah dijebak atas kepemilikan narkoba. Ia membantu geng Naga Putih nan terkenal, yang dipimpin oleh Philip Kwok, dalam perang antargeng yang mengerikan, tapi ia dikhianati.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang setia menguak sebuah jaringan pemerasan dan penipuan setelah suaminya ditipu oleh seorang penari perut yang licik. Saat sang penari ditikam, keadaan pun menjadi semakin tak terkendali.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Pencuri permata Fragrant Night dan Nocturnal Earl, yang merupakan saingan, melakukan perjalanan ke Jepang untuk mencuri berlian air mata venus nan terkenal.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Alex menjalani pernikahan bahagia dengan istrinya Tung, seorang ginekolog. Saat Alex terluka parah dalam sebuah kecelakaan, ia merasa harus memberitahu Tung tentang perselingkuhannya dengan Blackie.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: Saat berandalan Zhen dan sahabatnya Chia mengumpulkan bukti-bukti korupsi para pejabat, mereka menuntut untuk menjadi gubernur di negara itu.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: Saat berandalan Zhen dan sahabatnya Chia mengumpulkan bukti-bukti korupsi para pejabat, mereka menuntut untuk menjadi gubernur di negara itu.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: Seorang anak polisi bernama Kuo menyalahkan ayahnya atas kematian sang ibu. Ia menganggur dan menghabiskan waktunya di klub malam. Suatu malam, ia menyelamatkan Mei yang hampir dirudapaksa dan mereka menjadi teman.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Beberapa tahun sebelum film Ghostbusters sukses di Hollywood, Wong Jing menulis film komedi supranatural yang dibintangi oleh Alexander Fu dan disutradarai oleh Lau Ka Wing ini.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Tu Meng-Fei menyelamatkan seorang murid wanita, Mu Wan-Erh, dan gadis lainnya, Li Sai-Nan, dari pemimpin dunia kriminal Leng Tien-Lei. Li ingin membalas dendam pada Leng yang membunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: Dalam film yang merangkai misteri dan ketegangan dengan aksi kung fu ini, seorang ahli kung fu membalas dendam setelah mendekam selama 15 tahun di penjara. Ia mampu bertahan menghadapi ujian di sepanjang hidupnya!

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li berperan dalam kisah tentang dua pelajar yang berupaya membujuk orangtua mereka untuk merestui pernikahan mereka. Pasangan kekasih ini menjalankan sebuah rencana yang mereka kira mudah: berpura-pura mati!

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: Di kota, ia berhadapan dengan putra seorang bandit kejam dan seorang PSK yang disiksa. Sejak itu, pertarungan demi pertarungan terjadi saat kekuatan 'Crazy Lo Han Fist' yang dikuasainya menghancurkan geng-geng jahat.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun tak mau menyuap seorang pelukis kekaisaran sehingga si pelukis menggambar potret jelek dirinya, yang membuatnya tak dipilih oleh Kaisar sampai mereka bertemu langsung.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Bintang-bintang Shaw Brothers dan TVB bersatu untuk film epik karya Wang Feng ini. Masalah muncul ketika seorang gangster berencana untuk mengubah tempat favorit penduduk Gossip Street menjadi sebuah sarang perjudian.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: Dalam Sex, Love, And Hate, Chu Yuan menggabungkan bintang dari genre film kungfu dan film dewasa untuk mengangkat perbedaan pandangan masyarakat Hong Kong tentang cinta dan apa yang diinginkan wanita dari cinta.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: Pemerintah Qing menugaskan para petarung untuk menghancurkan Kuil Shaolin dan membunuh semua muridnya, tetapi dua di antaranya berhasil lolos. Mereka berlatih di bawah guru yang berbeda dan berniat membalas dendam.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Dalam film peraih penghargaan di tahun 1978 ini, Liu Yu-Te kabur ke Kuil Shaolin dan menguasai 35 jurus Kung Fu Shaolin. Setelah berhasil membalaskan dendamnya, ia berlatih Jurus ke-36.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: Sebuah film misteri supranatural dengan seorang detektif yang menyelidiki pembunuhan yang tampaknya merupakan akibat dari kutukan.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung adalah seorang pemuda yang nakal namun saleh, tetapi setelah serangkaian insiden, ayahnya yang frustrasi menyuruh seorang guru bela diri mabuk untuk mendisiplinkannya.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Di Cina tahun 1920-an, seorang bandit tiba di kota provinsi terpencil dengan menyamar sebagai wali kota baru, di mana ia berhadapan dengan bangsawan lokal yang kejam.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Di sebuah pusat perbelanjaan di Hong Kong, intuisi Buck Yuen (Jackie Chan) memperingatkannya. Ia menyelamatkan hasil rampasan perampokan dan muncul di televisi, akhirnya sampai di Istanbul melalui Korea Selatan, dan tanpa sengaja menjadi mata-mata. Untungnya, ia menguasai Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow berangkat ke kota besar untuk mencoba menyelamatkan rumahnya dengan memenangkan turnamen snooker besar.

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh hubungan antara Stanly Ho dan istri keempatnya, Angela, film ini adalah komedi romantis tentang seorang miliarder yang jatuh cinta dengan seorang dealer kasino yang bersemangat.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Petinju dunia kriminal, Lin Feng, diburu oleh triad asal Bangkok kala ia menolak bertarung dalam sebuah pertandingan ilegal. Lin Feng berhasil melarikan diri, tetapi ia kehilangan ingatannya.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Mantan kapten SWAT, Dong Gu, menderita kehilangan penglihatan traumatis kala gagal menjalankan misi. Namun, musuh bebuyutannya muncul dan membuat putrinya dalam bahaya. Ia pun harus berjuang menyelamatkan putrinya.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: Seorang biksu ulung berusaha melindungi seorang dokter muda yang naif dari iblis ular berusia seribu tahun. Pertarungan kekuatan psikis berujung pada kekacauan.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming menyusupi kepolisian atas suruhan triad, sementara Yan adalah polisi yang menyamar sebagai anggota triad. Menjalani kehidupan ganda membuat keduanya merasa terjebak dalam kebohongan dan ingin mencari jalan keluar.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: Klan Black Feather nan jahat menyusup ke wilayah Master Fire Cloud dan mencuri Topeng Shura, sehingga melepaskan roh jahat nan masih bayi. Namun, Master Fire Cloud mengadopsi bayi itu untuk mencegahnya menjadi jahat.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Koresponden lokal dan tim produksi lokal menyajikan kisah-kisah yang otoritatif dan mendalam dari seluruh benua Afrika.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: Acara bisnis unggulan CGTN English Channel, yang menyajikan data ekonomi, tren bisnis, dan kebijakan terbaru. Dan acara wawancara 30 menit BIZtalk, menyajikan profil 360 derajat para penggerak dan pengguncang industri, pionir teknologi, dan pembuat kebijakan, untuk memberi Anda kejelasan tentang apa yang terjadi di setiap aspek bisnis.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: Misinya adalah mengeksplorasi dinamika perdagangan internasional yang berubah secara dramatis melalui percakapan yang hidup dengan bahasa yang jelas dan tidak berbelit-belit. Dari seluruh dunia

programme.title: World Insight With Tian Wei

programme.title: Unnatural
programme.desc: Perubahan iklim dunia membuat sebuah perusahaan melakukan rekayasa genetik pada sekelompok beruang kutub Alaska yang ternyata memberi dampak nan mengerikan dan mematikan.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: Setelah mengamati hasil pemindaian CAT abnormal yang sangat familiar pada seorang gadis berusia 13 tahun, ahli radiologi Nina Evanko berjuang untuk menemukan sumber gangguan tidur yang dialami gadis muda itu. Apa yang ia temukan lebih gelap dan aneh dari yang dapat ia bayangkan.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Mengikuti seekor anjing yang merupakan ahli melarikan diri, yang harus bekerja sama dengan teman-teman anak anjingnya untuk mencegah blok mereka dirampok.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: Berlatar saat Perang Dunia II, sekelompok tentara Angkatan Darat Amerika dikirim dalam misi rahasia untuk menemukan komandan mereka yang hilang.

programme.title: Hotel Dunsmuir
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda dengan kemampuan indra keenam melarikan diri dari suaminya yang kasar, hanya untuk sampai di sebuah hotel bersejarah yang dihuni oleh kehadiran yang menyeramkan.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: Sekelompok mahasiswa menghabiskan malam di sebuah rumah besar tua yang menyeramkan, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seorang penguntit yang mengerikan sedang mengawasi setiap gerakan mereka saat ia memulai rencana untuk mengambil alih artefak penduduk asli Amerika kuno yang ada di dalamnya.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Seorang kurir khusus ditugaskan untuk mengirim sebuah kotak misterius ke dunia pembunuh bayaran nan berbahaya.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Seorang perawat asal Inggris lolos dari serangan di pos terdepan. Saat ia diburu oleh kelompok yang dipimpin Jerman, ia memulai perjalanan epik demi menyelamatkan pos terdekat dengan bantuan dari pejuang setempat.

programme.title: The Housekeeper

programme.title: Greatest Warriors, Ep 1
programme.desc: History's Greatest Warriors mengulas proses pembentukan berbagai pasukan tempur paling disegani sepanjang sejarah, mulai dari Viking, Samurai, Spartan, Knights Templar, Mongol, Navy SEAL, Delta Force, hingga prajurit Aztec. Setiap episode menelusuri perjalanan seorang prajurit sejak proses seleksi, latihan yang sangat berat, penguasaan senjata, strategi bertempur, hingga nilai-nilai yang membentuk mereka menjadi petarung elite. Dipadukan dengan analisis sejarah, rekonstruksi pertempuran, dan penjelasan dari para ahli, serial ini memberikan gambaran mendalam tentang rahasia di balik lahirnya para pejuang paling tangguh di dunia.

programme.title: Forged In Fire S10, Ep 16
programme.desc: Tim Forged in Fire is On The Road menjelajahi Amerika untuk mencari pandai besi terbaik. Hari ini, kita menuju ke toko pandai besi Clay Spencer yang terkenal di dunia di Pegunungan Appalachian, Carolina Utara.

programme.title: Alone S12, Ep 1
programme.desc: Para peserta yang tersisa terus menghadapi konsekuensi dari tindakan mereka. Persediaan makanan salah satu peserta terancam, sementara peserta lainnya mengungkap rahasia yang membahayakan peluang mereka untuk menang.

programme.title: Greatest Machines, Ep 2
programme.desc: Membahas dampak mesin terhadap sejarah, termasuk mesin cetak, Model T, dan komputer pribadi generasi awal.

programme.title: Hazardous History S1, Ep 6
programme.desc: Perjalanan nostalgia dari masa lalu Amerika, mengungkap aktivitas dan produk sehari-hari yang mengejutkan, mulai dari mainan berbahaya hingga barang-barang rumah tangga yang membahayakan, dulu yang dianggap normal kini tak terbayangkan dalam masyarakat modern.

programme.title: Mega-Brands That... S2, Ep 8

Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Mimpi bahagia Arina (Febby Rastanty) berubah jadi ancaman saat hari pernikahannya bersama Reno (Randy Jhon) dihancurkan oleh Fico (Rangga Azof) yang dikuasai dendam keluarga! saksikan kisahnya dalam sinetron biarkan hati bicara

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Arina hidup dalam bayang-bayang masa lalu yang kelam. Saat ia akhirnya menemukan harapan melalui pernikahan dengan pria yang dicintainya, takdir justru mempertemukannya dengan sebuah pengkhianatan yang mengubah hidupnya. Terjebak dalam keluarga yang dipenuhi dendam, rahasia, dan kebencian, Arina harus mengungkap kebenaran sebelum semuanya terlambat.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Decibel (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang mantan komandan angkatan laut menerima panggilan telepon dari pria tak dikenal yang menyatakan telah memasang bom di lokasi yang dipenuhi orang. Bom tersebut adalah "bom suara" yang akan meledak saat suara sekitar melebihi 100 desibel. Mantan komandan angkatan laut pun berusaha mati-matian menghentikan serangan teror tersebut.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.desc: “Healing Jalur King Nassar” is not just about sharing stories; it also invites participants to rediscover their zest for life through music, interaction, games, and even a “healing recipe” before heading home.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. Hubungan mereka yang buruk menjadi lebih buruk ketika Elsa tahu bahwa Nino akan menikahi Andin. Pernikahan Nino dan Andin mendapat dukungan sang ayah, namun ditentang oleh sang ibu.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Ketika kehilangan mengubah segalanya, Luna harus bangkit, menemukan kembali harapannya dan menghadapi pertemuan yang tak pernah ia duga. Akankah pertemuan itu menjadi awal dari kebahagiaan atau justru membawa luka yang lebih besar?

channel.display-name: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: The sadistic William Lewis (Schreiber) escapes from prison, arbitrarily killing as he goes. Concerned for Benson's safety, a security detail is assigned to her 24/7, but it doesn't take long for Lewis to get her back where he left off. With time running out, Benson must decide how much she's willing to sacrifice in order to save the life of a child.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.desc: 3 Little Kittens, Roadtrip Song, 5 Cute Fruits and more fun songs to be danced to in this episode

programme.title: The Adventures of Annie & Ben
programme.desc: Join Annie, Ben and Mango on a South African jungle safari, where they try to reunite two rhino calves with their mother. Watch them drive through a river, get chased by an angry adult rhino and, in Mango's case, get pulled into a mud bath!

programme.title: The Adventures of Annie & Ben
programme.desc: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? It's... a UFO! Annie, Ben and Mango encounter an alien in the Nevada desert, who offers to take them to the moon! What gravity-defying adventures await them there? Watch this alien-tastic episode to find out

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Lay the Favorite

programme.title: Unlikely Angel

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

programme.title: Generation Um...
programme.desc: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: A Vigilante
programme.desc: A vigilante helps victims escape their domestic abusers.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Laggies
programme.desc: When 28-year-old Megan attends her 10-year high-school reunion, she realizes that very little in her life has changed. An unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend sparks panic in Megan, causing her to wander off into the night. She meets 16-year-old Annika and proceeds to get drunk. Deciding she needs a break from her unfulfilling life, she tells her boyfriend she's going to a seminar but hangs with Annika.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Plots with a View
programme.desc: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

programme.title: Index Zero
programme.desc: 2035, a couple enters illegally in the United States of Europe. Here, an 'Index of Sustainability' is given to every citizen, calculated on their personal productivity and wellbeing. She is pregnant and is 'not sustainable'. She must to be expelled.

programme.title: Saving Sally
programme.desc: Marty, a comic book artist, falls for his saviour Sally, a feisty gadget inventor. Afraid Sally might be getting abused by her adoptive parents, Marty strives to save her.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James "The Amazing" Randi.

programme.title: Get Close
programme.desc: Tony Turner loses his father while in prison due to health issues. When he leaves prison, he meets a young lady named Kimaya, who he begins to fall in love with but refuses to allow her in, all while ducking the guy whose drugs he went to prison for.

programme.title: Target List
programme.desc: After announcing a ground-breaking cancer cure, five research team members are targeted by an assassin hired by big pharma. Two researchers soon find themselves framed for the crime and on the killer's target list when they escape the attack.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Slant
programme.desc: Melbourne. 1999. Christmas time! In this darkly comic thriller, a rogue journalist unearths the sordid secrets of an infamous missing socialite for the scoop of a lifetime while unwittingly dredging up his family trauma.

programme.title: Give Me Liberty
programme.desc: When protests cause road closures in Milwaukee, a medical transport driver is torn between his job and a request from his elderly Russian relatives.

programme.title: Authors Anonymous
programme.desc: When a dysfunctional group of unpublished writers accepts Hannah into their fold, the last thing they expect is her overnight success. Can these lovable misfits achieve their artistic dreams and avoid killing one another in the process?

programme.title: Caroline and Jackie
programme.desc: A birthday celebration exposes the fragile bond between two sisters. Dark secrets surface, unraveling the intricacies of their relationship and the profound impact of hidden truths on their lives.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: Set in modern-day Greece, Worlds Apart is comprised of three separate narratives, each following a love story between a foreigner and a Greek.

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: All Superheroes Must Die
programme.desc: Four Super Heroes find themselves abducted by their Arch Nemesis and are forced to compete in a series of challenges in order to save an abandoned town full of kidnapped innocent civilians.

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Lynch: A History
programme.desc: Lynch: A History is a kaleidoscopic look at Marshawn Lynch's use of silence as a form of protest. Culling 700 clips and placing them in radical juxtaposition, the film is a powerful parable about American sports media and racial oppression.

programme.title: Instant Dreams
programme.desc: When Polaroid announced the end of instant film in 2008, many feared the chemical formula would be lost forever. Instant Dreams follows a number of quirky individuals who are connected to Polaroid, who work and create to keep the magic of instant film.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Molli and Max in the Future
programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: Julien & Claire
programme.desc: When musician Julian and ballet dancer Claire meet on a bridge in Paris, the chance encounter accelerates their lives for a few days.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: After running away from home, Charlotte seeks refuge with an older man. Through many questionable revelations, she fears she may have put herself in more danger than where she came from.

programme.title: Dog Jack
programme.desc: A 14-year-old slave escapes with his loyal dog to join the Union Army. Hounded by slave trackers, he receives the reluctant help of a minister to reach the army of the North.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Blunt Force Trauma
programme.desc: In the seedy underground dueling culture of South America, two opponents wearing Kevlar vests face each other, draw and shoot. With Mickey Rourke.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: When a series of uncanny deja vu events begin to occur, a man must re-examine his tragic past and instinct.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions
programme.desc: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

programme.title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
programme.desc: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk II
programme.desc: Having failed a secret mission for the Red Flower Society, Chinese folk hero Fong Sai Yuk (Jet Li) must try to get his hands on a special document by wooing the governor's daughter, Man-Yin (Amy Kwok). This doesn't sit well with his fiancée, Ting Ting (Michelle Reis), or with his martial arts-master mother (Josephine Hsiao). Fong enters a martial arts competition, where he faces off against the villainous Yu (Chuen-Hua Chi) as he battles to restore the Ming Dynasty.

programme.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
programme.desc: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

programme.title: Cobra Verde
programme.desc: Francisco Manoel da Silva (Klaus Kinski) plays an enterprising young Brazilian who, after impregnating the three daughters of his plantation-owning employer, is sent to West Africa to round up slaves. Francisco goes to great lengths to befriend the very people he hopes to enslave -- eventually managing to overthrow a mad monarch and set himself up as king.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: In late-1970s suburban London, Chris (Christian Bale) and Marion (Emily Watson) have settled into a comfortable yet all-too-predictable middle-class existence. Chris receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited friend Toni (Lee Ross), a reunion that reminds him of a more carefree time in the 1960s Paris. Now, with lingering doubts about his marriage bubbling up, Chris must make the choice between revisiting his youthful abandon with Toni or facing the here and now with Marion.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: June is a wannabe influencer who's juggling multiple problems: her parents want her to move out, her ex-boyfriend accuses her of stalking him, and two detectives think she may be involved in the robbery of a local pharmacy.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders).

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Tiffany (Jamie Foxx), Charlie (Gabriel Byrne) and Vernon (Thandie Newton) are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens (Dina Merrill), a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings (Stuart Townsend) to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Mob assassin Jeffrey (Chow Yun-Fat) is no ordinary hired gun; the best in his business, he views his chosen profession as a calling rather than simply a job. So, when beautiful nightclub chanteuse Jennie (Sally Yeh) is blinded in the crossfire of his most recent hit, Jeffrey chooses to retire after one last job to pay for his unintended victim's sight-restoring operation. But when Jeffrey is double-crossed, he reluctantly joins forces with a rogue policeman (Danny Lee) to make things right.

programme.title: Villains
programme.desc: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

programme.title: Language Lessons
programme.desc: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

programme.title: Chopping Mall
programme.desc: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.

programme.title: The Wendell Baker Story
programme.desc: Career con artist Wendell Baker (Luke Wilson) discovers he has a talent for straightening out tense situations. Following his release from jail, he decides to pursue a new career in the hospitality industry, and winds up at a retirement home. His new boss (Owen Wilson) is a mean-spirited man who steals the residents' money and treats them like slaves, and tries to involve Wendell in his schemes. Instead, Wendell casts his lot with the residents and helps them fight back.

programme.title: Dreamscape
programme.desc: Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.

programme.title: Deadly Outlaw: Rekka
programme.desc: A yakuza (Riki Takeuchi) becomes the target of two clans after the murder of his beloved boss.

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: For five men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller, Eric Stonestreet, Matthias Schoenaerts), the opportunity to share a penthouse in the city -- in which to carry on extramarital affairs -- is a dream come true, until the dead body of an unknown woman turns up. Realizing that her killer must be one of their group, the men are gripped by paranoia as each one suspects another. Friendships are tested, loyalties are questioned, and marriages crumble while fear and suspicion run rampant.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: A young woman must foil the terrorist who killed her parents before he strikes again on the island of Nantucket.

Troubled Italian filmmaker Guido Anselmi (Marcello Mastroianni) struggles with creative stasis as he attempts to get a new movie off the ground. Overwhelmed by his work and personal life, the director retreats into his thoughts, which often focus on his loves, both past and present, and frequently wander into fantastical territory. As he tries to sort out his many entanglements, romantic and otherwise, Anselmi finds his production becoming more and more autobiographical.

programme.title: Hearts Beat Loud
programme.desc: In the hip Brooklyn neighborhood of Red Hook, single dad and record store owner Frank is preparing to send his hard-working daughter Sam off to college while being forced to close his vintage shop. Hoping to stay connected through their shared musical passions, Frank urges Sam to turn their weekly jam sessions into a father-daughter live act. After their first song becomes an internet breakout, the two embark on a journey of love, growing up and musical discovery.

programme.title: The Dead Girl
programme.desc: In a quintet of stories, the murder of a young runaway connects a group of unrelated women. Lonely Arden discovers the body; Leah, a forensics student, thinks the victim may be her long-missing sister. Melora arrives in Los Angeles to piece together the last days of her daughter's life, while Ruth makes a disturbing discovery in the storage facility she and her husband manage.

programme.title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
programme.desc: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

programme.title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
programme.desc: One year after avenging his brother's murder, MMA champion Kurt Sloane finds himself imprisoned by a powerful gangster in Thailand. To win back his freedom, he must train for a fight against a 400-pound killer in an underground death match.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: An assassin goes to Thailand in order to solve a kidnapping case and finds himself chased by a man whose sibling he killed.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: Bong is a highly respected cop with a long history of success on dangerous cases. However, his past soon comes back to haunt him when his former protégé seeks revenge against all those who have wronged him.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

programme.title: Enter the Fat Dragon
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the mysterious death of a suspect who was in his custody during a routine transfer.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: Legend of the fist
programme.desc: Chen fakes his death and returns as a caped crime fighter.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

programme.title: Hunt the Wicked
programme.desc: Detective Huang Mingjin faces off against criminal mastermind Wei Yunzhou in a city plagued by dark secrets. As police and criminals flood the streets, Huang must unravel the city's sinister core while engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with Wei.

programme.title: Ip Man: The Awakening
programme.desc: After stopping a kidnapping, a young Ip Man becomes the target of a human trafficking ring and must face the group's brutal boxing champion head-on.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.

programme.title: Gundala
programme.desc: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Members of an international task force seek justice against the leader of an Asian drug cartel and his murderous henchmen.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
